capabilities: Track time per day, note and project
Run Pomodoro focus sessions with breaks
Show time and writing statistics on an arrangeable page
Assign time to project sections from a Simple Gantt timeline
Save PDF or image reports of project time
disambiguation: Not only a decorative clock face; it records time per note and project and builds reports from it.
extras: Works entirely offline with no network requests and writes only its own data.json plus requested reports. Multi-device use requires version 1.14 or later on every device; the README notes it may not yet be listed in the community plugin browser, so manual install is described.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to see how long you spend writing, which notes or projects that time went to, or to run timed focus sessions.

relations.evidence: link a project to a Simple Gantt timeline and see the hours on each phase and task

summary: Watch overlay for Obsidian that tracks time per day, note and project, runs Pomodoro focus sessions, and shows writing stats and PDF reports.
